ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of low-intensity (dark charcoal) to high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels, with high-intensity pixels primarily clustered in the lower medial regions and distal trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive white mottling and dendritic patterns originating from the fluke base and lower lobe margins, transitioning into solid dark pigmentation towards the upper trailing edge; high-density white spotting observed on the lower right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with an estimated internal pixel angle of 85 degrees and a moderate depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (crenulations) along the entire trailing edge; right lobe exhibits larger, more distinct semi-circular protrusions compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature following the central notch transitioning into a convex sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Massive, high-contrast brownish-white textured clusters of barnacle colonization (Coronula spp.) at the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct white vertical and diagonal rake marks (linear pixel disruptions) visible across the dark pigmentation of both lobes, particularly concentrated near the fluke base and center-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle infestation on lobe tips and extensive white rake mark scarring across the ventral surface.
